text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during lunch break,
while walking across the academy grounds—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Energy for the body!
Crisp and freshhh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You won't believe it, but I'm going to be
in a sports drink commercial!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Apparently the manufacturer contacted the academy, saying I'd be the perfect fit for the job.
choice_data_list: It definitely fits the image perfectly.
It definitely fits the image perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, hearing you say that
gets me totally pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I initially thought about turning it down.
It was just so sudden, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: “Still, being rooted for like Trainer does for me now made me so happy...”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna go all in and do it!
For the sake of everyone who supported me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All right, I gotta make a great commercial!
Refreshing and fresh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After school that day—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Catch my breath, then—refresh and revitaliiize...!
All right, I'm good to go...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it almost feels like we're about to run in a race.

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get this photoshoot started!
Mejiro Ryan, you're up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yes! Please!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Energy for the body! Crisp and fresh!

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Alright, cuuut!
We're checking the footage, so please wait a moment~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, physically I'm not tired at all, but the nervous exhaustion is unreal.

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text: ...Hrrrm, what should I do about this...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um, did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text: Well, your acting is flawless, but... it's just not quite the vibe I had in mind, I suppose...

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text: "I just feel like... we haven't brought out all of Mejiro Ryan's charm—what makes her *her*."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Being myself"...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to acting, I'm sure there are
plenty of people out there who are far better than me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The people who backed me did it because they
believed I was the right one for the job, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... How am I supposed to express
my 'individuality'?
choice_data_list: Showing them the real thing instead of just acting, huh
How about trying to show a bit more dynamism?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The real thing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I see! Sweat, breathing, all of it—you want to show the real thing, not an act!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Moving my body like I always do is what makes me 'me', after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Excuse me, could you give me just a moment?
I'm going to go run!"

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! That might actually convey
a much more authentic message!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
All right, let's get right to it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: *Haa*... *haa*... Thanks, Nature-chan!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, it's totally fine, but...
aren't you unusually fired up today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, just wanted to work up a good sweat!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You're really training with everything you've got.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Dober, great timing!
Come on, let's run alongside each other!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Wait, that makes no sense at all?!

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Beads of sweat, flushed cheeks, and a refreshing expression!
Yes! That's what a sporty girl is all about!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After doing several more paired runs,
Mejiro Ryan was completely exhausted and drenched in sweat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to those efforts, the commercial shoot was a success,
and sales of the drink increased.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Such dynamism...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see! There was one crucial thing
I was missing to truly show who I am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Excuse me! Would you mind moving to a different spot!?
Please follow me for a second!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"When you think of me, you think 'muscles'!
Muscles were what I was missing!"

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text: Huh...? M-Muscles?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Let's warm up those muscles right away!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Let's muscle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
First is the bench press!
See, look, the pecs are starting to wake up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the deltoids and forearm muscles are waking up too!
They're asking, "Is it our turn yet?"~!

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text: ...I don't really understand what those words mean, but it's certainly dynamic...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm hitting my stride! Next up, let's wake up those leg muscles with the leg press!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Let's muscle-up!

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey! Keep rolling the camera!
This has a charm you can't get from any script!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan being her natural self was a huge hit with the camera crew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long, when the commercial aired, its striking
content led to a surge in beverage sales as well.
